name: odoo-ai-agents
description: Odoo AI workforce toolkit - 50 skills + 23 specialist agents + 8 workflow commands across engineering, sales, marketing, strategy, setup, visual UI testing, and automated multi-module git integration. Pairs with the odoo-semantic-mcp server for indexed-codebase grounding (auto-installed). Includes browser-automation agents for Odoo UI review and automated setup.

speech_api_key.title: Speech endpoint key
speech_api_key.description: Leave empty when Claude Code asks at install. Fill it later, after /odoo-ai-agents:odoo-setup voice declared the endpoint, through /plugin > odoo-ai-agents > Configure: the value sent as bearer to that endpoint (speech.toml auth = bearer; an open endpoint needs none).

youtube_client_id.title: YouTube OAuth client id
youtube_client_id.description: Leave empty when Claude Code asks at install: 75-youtube.sh consent (run by you, once per channel) reads it from the downloaded client JSON of your Google Cloud project's Desktop OAuth client and stores it here.

youtube_client_secret.title: YouTube OAuth client secret
youtube_client_secret.description: Leave empty when Claude Code asks at install: stored by 75-youtube.sh consent from the same client JSON.

youtube_refresh_token_docs.title: YouTube refresh token - docs channel
youtube_refresh_token_docs.description: Leave empty when Claude Code asks at install: obtained and stored by 75-youtube.sh consent --channel <purpose> for the channel in youtube.toml slot docs (the account that owns it approves in the browser).

youtube_refresh_token_marketing.title: YouTube refresh token - marketing channel
youtube_refresh_token_marketing.description: Leave empty when Claude Code asks at install: obtained and stored by 75-youtube.sh consent --channel <purpose> for the channel in youtube.toml slot marketing (optional).

youtube_refresh_token_third.title: YouTube refresh token - third channel
youtube_refresh_token_third.description: Leave empty when Claude Code asks at install: obtained and stored by 75-youtube.sh consent --channel <purpose> for a third channel in youtube.toml slot third (optional).
